notes: Psalms 83:2 2 For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
16 Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
This psalm is much like the 27th, 42nd, 43rd, and 63rd, and may have been composed on the same occasion with the former, when David was banished from Jerusalem by Absalom his son, 2 Sam. 15-16.
